Privacy Policy

Last updated: 19 October 2026

1. Who We Are

Aho Farms Limited ("Aho Farms", "we", "us", or "our") is a New Zealand company registered under the Companies Act 1993, operating a licensed medicinal cannabis cultivation and supply business from Hawke's Bay, New Zealand.

We are committed to protecting the privacy of individuals who interact with our website, and we handle all personal information in accordance with the Privacy Act 2020 (NZ) and the thirteen Information Privacy Principles (IPPs) it contains.

Privacy Officer: admin@ahofarms.com  |  Aho Farms Limited, Hawke's Bay, New Zealand

2. What Information We Collect

We collect personal information only where it is necessary for a legitimate business purpose. The types of information we collect depend on how you interact with our website:

Contact Form Submissions

When you submit an enquiry through our website contact form, we collect: your name, email address, organisation or company name, and the content of your message. This is the minimum required to respond meaningfully to your enquiry.

Consumer Portal Enquiries

When you ask to be connected with a prescriber through our Consumer Portal, we collect: your name, email address, mobile number, country and region, your contact and consultation preferences, how you heard about us, and any message you choose to leave, together with confirmation that you meet the applicable age requirement and your consent. We do not ask for medical information. We use these details to identify the approved independent prescriber partner for your market, to make the introduction (by email, referral link or QR code) and to follow up on your enquiry, and we share them only with that partner. Enquiries are stored securely with a reference code and referral status so we can support you and measure the pathway.

Newsletter Subscriptions

If you subscribe to our professional newsletter, we collect your email address and optionally your professional category (e.g. GP, pharmacist, nurse practitioner) so we can send relevant content.

Website Analytics

We use Google Analytics 4 through Google Tag Manager to understand visits and interactions on selected public pages. Analytics are on by default unless you opt out below, your browser sends a Global Privacy Control or Do Not Track signal, or browser storage is unavailable. Our portals and patient-access pages are excluded. Page addresses are limited to reviewed public paths without query strings or fragments. Referrers are limited to reviewed internal paths or external origins. Normal campaign labels are retained from standard UTM parameters, with checks for obvious email addresses, phone numbers and oversized values. Campaign links must not contain personal or health information. We do not send names, email addresses, form contents or health information to analytics, and do not use these analytics for advertising or remarketing. HubSpot tracking is not enabled. Standard Enhanced Measurement can record scrolling, outbound clicks, file downloads, supported video engagement and form interactions. Form interaction events describe the form and its destination or submit button; they do not contain typed field values, and a form-submit event is not confirmation that an enquiry was successfully delivered. Site Search measurement is not used because this website has no public search feature. Our additional email-click event records intent to contact us, not a completed enquiry.

Google can receive cookie identifiers, basic browser and device information, page-view and session information, and network information such as your IP address when your browser connects to its service. These data can relate to an individual; we do not describe them as anonymous. See Google’s privacy policy for its processing practices. Use the controls in Section 7 to turn optional analytics off for this browser.

Cookies

Our website uses cookies, small text files stored on your device. See Section 7 for full details of our cookie use.

3. Why We Collect It

We collect and use personal information for the following purposes, each of which constitutes a lawful basis under the Privacy Act 2020:

  • To respond to enquiries, so we can provide timely and relevant responses to messages submitted via our contact form.
  • To verify professional registration, to confirm that portal access requests are made by eligible healthcare professionals, as required by our licence conditions.
  • To send newsletters, to deliver professional updates, product information, and regulatory news to opted-in subscribers only.
  • To improve our website, we use basic analytics to understand visits to our public website and improve its content.
  • To comply with legal and regulatory obligations, we may be required by law to retain certain records or disclose information to regulators, including the Ministry of Health, Medsafe, or the New Zealand Police.

We do not use your personal information for automated decision-making, profiling, or any purpose unrelated to the above.

4. How We Store and Protect It

We take reasonable technical and organisational measures to protect personal information against loss, unauthorised access, use, modification, or disclosure.

  • Contact form data is handled by our website enquiry service for forwarding to the Aho Farms team. HubSpot forms are not currently embedded on this website.
  • Optional analytics are processed by Google when enabled in your browser. They are separate from enquiry and portal data. HubSpot tracking is not enabled.
  • Newsletter subscriptions are handled by our website subscription service and passed to our team for list management.
  • Portal access credentials are managed with industry-standard security practices. Passwords are hashed and salted, they are never stored in plaintext.
  • Health information: Please do not include medical or health details in website enquiries. We are not a healthcare provider. Free-text enquiries can contain information you choose to provide.
  • Data retention: Contact our Privacy Officer for the retention period and deletion arrangements applicable to your enquiry or portal account.

5. Who We Share It With

We do not sell, rent, or trade your personal information. We use service providers for website hosting, email delivery and storage where configured. Consumer Portal referrals are shared with the approved independent prescriber partner as described in Section 2. Google processes optional website analytics as described in Section 2. HubSpot tracking is not enabled.

For information about the providers handling your enquiry, processing locations or safeguards for an overseas transfer, contact our Privacy Officer. We do not claim that a provider's certification alone establishes compliance with New Zealand privacy law.

We may also disclose personal information if required to do so by New Zealand law, or in response to a lawful request from a government agency or regulatory body (including the Ministry of Health, Medsafe, New Zealand Police, or the Office of the Privacy Commissioner).

We take reasonable steps to assess the privacy safeguards for overseas disclosures where required.

6. Your Rights Under the NZ Privacy Act 2020

Under the Privacy Act 2020, you have the following rights in relation to personal information we hold about you:

  • Right of access (IPP 6): You may request a copy of personal information we hold about you.
  • Right to correction (IPP 7): If you believe information we hold is inaccurate, incomplete, or misleading, you may request that we correct it.
  • Right to request deletion: While not an absolute right under NZ law, we will consider requests to delete personal information where it is no longer needed for the purpose for which it was collected.
  • Right to unsubscribe: You may opt out of newsletter communications at any time using the unsubscribe link in any email, or by contacting us directly.

To exercise any of these rights, please contact our Privacy Officer at admin@ahofarms.com. We will acknowledge your request and respond within 20 working days, as required by the Privacy Act 2020. If we are unable to meet this timeframe, we will notify you and provide a revised date.

If you are not satisfied with our response, you have the right to complain to the Office of the Privacy Commissioner: www.privacy.org.nz.

7. Cookies

Our website uses the following categories of cookies:

Essential Cookies

Portal session cookies support sign-in and secure access. Blocking them may prevent those features from working. Your optional analytics preference is stored in this browser's local storage, separately from portal cookies.

Analytics Cookies

Google Analytics can set first-party cookies such as _ga and _ga_* to distinguish browsers and sessions. We do not use a CookieYes banner. Optional analytics are on by default; use the controls below to opt out or allow them again. Opting out stops optional analytics and clears accessible first-party Google Analytics cookies. It does not affect browsing or portal access. Your choice applies to this browser and can be lost if you clear its storage; other browsers and devices need their own choice. Global Privacy Control and Do Not Track signals keep analytics off.

This website applies the same browser analytics controls to all visitors. We do not infer your country from your language or browser settings, and do not currently operate a country-based consent mechanism. Contact our Privacy Officer about processing locations, retention arrangements or rights that apply to your circumstances.

Analytics settings

8. Children

This website is not intended for use by persons under the age of 18. We do not knowingly collect personal information from minors. If we become aware that we have inadvertently collected information from someone under 18, we will promptly delete it. If you believe a minor has submitted information to us, please contact us at admin@ahofarms.com.

9. Changes to This Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time to reflect changes in our practices, technology, legal requirements, or regulatory guidance. The "Last updated" date at the top of this page will reflect when the policy was most recently revised.

If we make material changes to how we collect or use personal information, we will notify users via a notice on our website homepage for a reasonable period. We encourage you to review this policy periodically.

10. Contact Us

For any questions, requests, or concerns relating to your privacy or this policy, please contact our Privacy Officer:

Privacy Officer
Aho Farms Limited
Hawke's Bay, New Zealand
admin@ahofarms.com

If you believe Aho Farms has interfered with your privacy in a way that breaches the Privacy Act 2020, you may make a complaint to the Office of the Privacy Commissioner:

  • Website: www.privacy.org.nz
  • Phone: 0800 803 909

We recommend contacting us first, as we are committed to resolving privacy concerns directly and promptly.
